##**Load Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

##**Loading Data Made in Last Rmd
```{r}
data.02 <- read_csv("data/clean.dt.elk.data.02.csv")

```

##**Exclude Addtional Columns That the csv File Read
```{r}
# The additional column was added because of the write.csv function in the 
# previous Rmd (instead of write_csv). I suggest removing this code chunk 
# because the additional columns from your original data frame are now present.
# data.02 <- data.02 %>%
#   select(time_diff,location)

```

##**Creating New Observations at >30 mins (1800s)
```{r}
new.obs <- data.02 %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  # This mutate adds a new column "observation" to capture the number of 
  # obsservations within a camera. Since you already grouped by camera, it should
  # operate by camera. The cumsum function goes sequentially throuhg all rows
  # and asks if time_diff is greater than 1800. If it is, it gets a new
  # observation number, so each observation greater than 1800 seconds becomes
  # a new observation until the next new observation is encountered. I've also 
  # added 1 to the cumsum because the first observation number is zero.
  mutate(observation = cumsum(time_diff > 1800 & !is.na(time_diff)) + 1)

```
